summary: Palmdale School District urges the FCC to preserve and strengthen E‑Rate, opposing sunset, geographic narrowing, and unfunded conditions, and to expand cybersecurity eligibility. Palmdale School District opposes shrinking E‑Rate, limits on eligibility, and unfunded conditions; it urges preservation of Head Start support and expansion of cybersecurity services.
